claims.claim: Added one disabled-by-default, read-only consult_flow interface restricted to the four caller-resolved Brain flows, with explicit Human opt-out.

Requests bind exact source, packet, material, sealed cut, candidate and selected subject, including failed RUN/head/Executor/FAILURE or reviewed RUN/REVIEW/finding/SHA/action; currentness checks surround consultation.
The adapter delegates advice validation to existing CAA-02 consult and preserves its bounded recommendations, citations, causal limits, falsifiers and finite outcomes.

Mapping and JSON transports share the strict bounded envelope and CAA-02 validator; four-flow fixtures specify semantic equivalence and malformed, overbudget, attribution, substitution and injection rejection cases.

Advice grants no authority, retains Brain final judgment, and leaves Human priority/risk, optional AOA and existing TASK scope, acceptance, verification and direct-family admission contracts unchanged.

Optional absence, opt-out and provider failures return bounded abstention without retries or audit invocation; existing source guards, sealed-cut authentication and task-only/as-of isolation remain in force.

Planning records the explicit 2026-10-24 CAA-03 selection, preserves prior selection and accepted lineage history, keeps TASK-411 separate, and leaves CAA-04/05 unselected without production activation.
The committed delta changes exactly the five permitted paths; existing Brain, authoring, CAA-01/02, audit-policy and lifecycle implementation files remain unchanged.
